title: 13-week cash forecast update
prompt: Update the 13-week cash forecast using current bank balances, open invoices, bills, payroll and recurring contractual commitments.

setup.q: How many days after the due date do customers pay on average?
Which recurring contractual payments are not in AP yet (rent, debt service, insurance) with amount and day of month?
Below what cash balance should a week be flagged?

inputs.name: Bank balances, AR aging, AP aging and the cash forecast

steps: pull current bank balances, open invoices with due dates, open bills with due dates and Dime's cash forecast
read the standing forecast workbook and the payroll schedule
run forecast_roll: roll the forecast forward one week, place receipts at due date plus collectionLagDays, bills at due date, payroll and recurringCommitments on their dates
run xlsx_update_in_place to write the new week columns into the standing workbook without touching its formulas; flag weeks whose closing cash is below minimumCash
write the exceptions workbook with the changes against last week's forecast

done.text: Opening cash in week 1 equals the current bank balances; the workbook carries thirteen week columns
Every exception row (a week below minimum cash, a change from last week) cites the week and the invoice, bill or commitment id
cash-forecast-exceptions.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Assumptions (collection lag, commitments, payroll dates) are stated on the forecast; the standing workbook keeps its formulas
